items.title: Ontogenically distinct mouse alveolar macrophages modulate cigarette smoke-induced lung inflammation via Spp1
items.author: Emma Doran
items.content: Fate-mapping of alveolar macrophages sheds light on the role of the cigarette smoke-exposed niche and osteopontin (Spp1) in driving cell dysfunction and tissue damage in the context of COPD.

items.title: Bee pathogen sharing and prevalence are linked with flower sharing and taxonomic distance within the bee community
items.author: Ivan Meeus
items.content: Combined pollen collection and flower visitation data show that bee pathogen sharing and prevalence increase with floral resource sharing, particularly between more closely related bee species.

items.title: Author Correction: Zearalenone causes female reproductive lipotoxicity through the ERα-CD36/TLR4 signaling pathway
items.author: Yang Li
items.content: Author Correction: Zearalenone causes female reproductive lipotoxicity through the ERα-CD36/TLR4 signaling pathway

items.title: Frequency-specific cortical subnetworks support fast human swallowing
items.author: Sonja Suntrup-Krueger
items.content: Source-resolved magnetoencephalography reveals frequency-specific cortical subnetworks that coordinate rapid human swallowing and provides a systems-level framework for cortical sensorimotor control.

items.title: N-linked glycosylation of the EP3α receptor is essential for the regulation of platelet homeostasis
items.author: Qian Liu
items.content: N-linked glycosylation of EP3α is critical for platelet regulation through modulation of PGE2/EP3α/Gi-mediated cAMP and Ca2+ signaling.

items.title: High-accuracy structural modeling of antibody-antigen complexes
items.author: Guijun Zhang
items.content: DeepAAAssembly enhances antibody-antigen complex modeling by integrating deep learning-based distance prediction with a global exploration and local exploitation conformational sampling strategy.

items.title: Genetic characterizations and seroprevalence of hepatitis B virus among non-human primates and human caretakers in Indonesia
items.author: Yasuko Mori
items.content: Screening of non-human primates and caretakers in Indonesia reveals hepatitis B virus DNA in East Javan langurs, clustering with gibbon strains despite divergent NTCP entry receptors, marking a host-tropism paradox at the primate–human interface.

items.title: Late cortical dynamics mediate numerosity illusions induced by symmetry
items.author: Elisa Castaldi
items.content: We use EEG and a symmetry-induced illusion to dissociate physical from perceived numerosity in dot arrays. Physical numerosity-related signals emerge early, whereas around 170 ms they interact with spatial arrangement, and symmetric arrays are represented as containing fewer dots than they physically do.
